_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro: Rydych chi'n chwarae Gwlff (Gêm Cerdyn) - Chwaraewr {player_id}. Nod: Cael y sgôr cyfanswm isaf yn y rownd sengl hwn. Os yw'r cologau'n rhannu'r un gwerth, maent yn cael eu cyfanswm fel 0. Gwerthiau cardiau: A=1, 2-10=werth wyneb, J/Q=10, K=0 Y gweithredoedd (defnyddio bracsiau union): - '[draw]' - Tynnu o deic - '[take]' - Cymryd o'r pentwr dileu - '[swap X Y]' - Troi'r cerdyn dileu gyda safle X (rhwng) Y (colwm) - '[discard]' - Dileu'r cerdyn dileu

board.drew: Rydych yn tynnu: {card} Nawr mae'n rhaid i chi [swap X Y] neu [discard] ei.
board.took:
You took: {card} from discard pile
You must [swap X Y] with it (cannot discard).

options.final_turns: Mae'r tro olaf! Eich opsiynau: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: You must: [swap X Y] (cannot discard cards from discard pile)
options.swap_or_discard: Rhaid i chi: [swap X Y] neu [discard]

action_desc.swapped: Chwaraewr {pid} yn cyfnewid {new} gyda {old} yn y sefyllfa ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Mae'r deic yn wag! Gêm yn dod i ben ar unwaith.
message.knocked: Chwaraewr {pid} wedi'i guro! Mae pob chwaraewr arall yn cael un tro arall.
message.final_round: Chwaraewr {pid} {reason}! Mae pob chwaraewr arall yn cael un tro arall.

invalid.wrong_action: Defnyddiwch un un o'r camau canlynol: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], neu [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Rhaid i chi gyntaf [draw], [take], [knock], neu [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Ni allwch daflu cerdyn a gymerwyd o'r pentwr daflu. Rhaid ei gyfnewid.
invalid.have_drawn_card: You have a drawn card. You must [swap X Y] or [discard] it.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Mae angen cerdyn wedi'i dynnu i gyfnewid.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Mae angen cerdyn wedi'i dynnu i'w daflu.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Safle allan o ffiniau. Defnyddiwch rhes 1-{max_row}, colofn 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Ni allwch guro gyda cherdyn wedi'i dynnu. Cwblhawch eich tro yn gyntaf.
invalid.already_knocked: Mae rhywun eisoes wedi taro rownd hwn.
invalid.already_revealed: Mae'r cerdyn hwnnw eisoes wedi'i datgelu!

summary.full: Gêm drosodd! Chwaraewr {winner} yn ennill gyda sgôr o {score} pwyntiau! Sgôr Terfynol: {scores}
